analyses.content: 录音里提到野餐时抬头看到了一大群鸟（huge flock of birds），这里的“huge flock of”直接替换了题目里的“large numbers of”，所以填birds。
你可能会在听到前面的“picnic”（野餐）时分心，只要牢牢盯住题目里表示数量的修饰词替换，就能准确定位答案。
And also, at one point, when we stopped for a picnic, I was lying in a field looking up and saw a huge flock of birds. They were obviously migrating. That's another reason why it's a good time to go.
录音里明确说你不住在酒店，而是住在一顶帐篷里（stay in a tent），所以填tent。
录音先抛出了“hotel（酒店）”作为干扰，但紧接着用了“don't stay”否定它，你需要听清肯定是哪一个、否定是哪一个。
Oh, and another thing, you don't stay in a hotel. You stay in a tent, so you don't have to come back to town in the evening.
录音明确指出你真正前往的目的地是山脉（heading for is the mountains），“heading for”对应题目中的“Final destination”，所以填mountains。
你可能听到前半句提到的“valleys（山谷）”就急着填，一定要注意听后面的转折词“but”以及强调最终目的地的表达。

So where do you go on the first day? Through some amazing wooded valleys full of chestnut and beech trees, but that's just the morning. Where you're really heading for is the mountains, and when you set out, you can only see them in the far distance. You don't actually get there until sunset.
录音提到第一天晚上你将有机会去游泳（opportunity to go for a swim），“opportunity”对应题目里的“chance”，所以填swim。
录音前面提到了白天的野餐和午睡干扰，你只要看死题目上的“Evening activity（晚上活动）”这个时间限制，就能避开陷阱。
But on that first evening, when you've been riding all day, you get the opportunity to go for a swim, and you really enjoy that. So relaxing.
录音说到在山谷的尽头有一个瀑布（waterfall），并紧接着说这是一个停下来吃午餐的好地方，所以填waterfall。
你可能会死等着“lunch”出现才去抓答案，但录音是先给出地点“waterfall”才提午餐，这要求你必须结合前后两句话来听懂整体语义。
And what's on day two? You said something about the national park. No. Day two, you go up this incredible valley. At the end of it, there's a waterfall. It's an amazing place to stop for lunch.
录音非常直白地说下午有一趟前往山洞（cave）的行程，完全对应题目信息，所以填cave。
你可能会被前面提到的老鹰（eagle）干扰，但只要听到“in the afternoon（在下午）”这个定海神针，就能直接锁定后面的真正答案。
We even spotted an eagle while we were sitting there, and in the afternoon, there's a trip that goes to a cave. You can even ride into it.
录音提醒你要当心背部（back）不能有毛病，因为骑马会加重它，“trouble with”对应题目的“problems”，所以填back。
你很容易听到一开始说的膝盖（knee）就往上填，但讲话人马上用“but”进行了转折，表示膝盖其实没问题，真正要当心的是背部。

So what are your tips for a horseback riding weekend? Well, I'd had a sore knee before I went, and I was pretty worried about that. It was okay, actually, but what you've got to watch for is that you don't have any trouble with your back. Riding can really aggravate that.
录音明确要求一定要确保穿步行靴（walking boots）以应对陡峭不平的道路，所以填walking boots。
你可能会抓取到句子最后的“riding boots”盲目填入，但前面明明有“not just”的否定词，一定要耐心把整个对比的句子听完。
Yeah. But another thing I hadn't realized is that you actually walk the horses down some pretty steep and uneven paths, so make sure you have walking boots, not just normal riding boots.
录音说如果在网上注册（register online），就能获得一个折扣（discount），“register online”直接替换了题目的“Book online”，所以填discount。
这题没有任何弯弯绕，你做错的唯一原因可能就是没听出“register”和“book”的同义替换，导致跟丢了答案所在句。

I think you've convinced me to sign up. When I was looking at the website, I saw that if I register online, I can get a discount. Did you do that or go through a travel agency? I registered online, of course.
录音明确提到要确保让你的保险（insurance）公司知道你参加了探险旅行，对应了题目的告知公司，所以填insurance。
前一句刚提到老板（boss），你可能会跟着话题跑偏，只要牢牢抓住题目中的核心定位词“company（公司）”去听它前面的修饰词就能得分。

I just have to let my boss know when I want to take time off. And then the other important thing I read was that you have to make sure that your insurance company know that you're going on an adventure trip to make sure that you're covered in case anything happens. I'm sure it won't, but better be safe than sorry.
